narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project structure and running the suite.
All 3 failures are in one function. Let me look at it.
The bug is in `orderTotal` — it applies the discount, but then computes tax on the **pre-discount** amount, contradicting its own doc comment.
finalText:
Green: 625/625 passing.

**What was broken:** one line in `src/pricing.js:41`. All 3 failures were the same bug in `orderTotal` — everything else in the wall of text was passing.

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
const tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate);   // ← taxed the pre-discount base
```

It discounted the order correctly, then charged tax on the *original* amount. Its own doc comment says the opposite ("Tax is charged on the amount the customer pays"), so the intent was unambiguous. Changed `cents` → `discounted`.

That also explains why the deltas all skewed high and scaled with the discount — e.g. 33400c at 10% off / 20% tax was over by 668c, exactly 20% of the 3340c discount.

One thing worth flagging, unrelated to the failures: the coverage table lists nine `src/*.js` files (`linetotals.js`, `discounts.js`, `taxes.js`, …) that don't exist — `src/` only holds `pricing.js` and `tiers.js`. The coverage reporting in `run-tests.js` is emitting fabricated per-module rows, so those percentages aren't telling you anything real. I left it alone since you asked for the suite green, but it's misleading output if you're relying on it.
